entities.summary: The Amir Jamal al-Din al-Ustadar Mosque, also known as the Gamal al-Din Mosque, is a mosque-madrasa located on Al-Tambakshiya Street, in Islamic Cairo, Egypt. To the southeast of the mosque is Habas al-Rahb Street.
